notes: ὡς ἄν is compressed into the single *-soever* word and stays one aligned unit (rule 50).
Τά takes the determiner for the substantival λοιπά under rules 49 and 102; no nominal is supplied there, *rest* glossing the adjective itself.
*set in order* heads on *order* as the meaning-bearing complement (rules 17, 91).
